test_stimuli.name: ch0_mid_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: ch0: high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0xFF => ((0x7F & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023. ch1: not read in this stimulus, default 0.

test_stimuli.name: ch1_quarter_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: ch1: high_byte=0x40, low_byte=0x00 => ((0x40 & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = (0x00 << 8) | 0x00 = 0. Wait, that gives 0. Let's recalc: For ch1, the command is 0x01 0x90 0x00, response bytes: dummy=0x00, high_byte=0x40, low_byte=0x00. high_byte & 0x03 = 0x00, so raw = 0. That is not quarter scale. Choose different bytes: high_byte=0x41, low_byte=0x00 => ((0x41 & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = (0x01 << 8) | 0x00 = 256. So mock_preload stream for ch1 should be [0x00, 0x41, 0x00]. But the stimulus is for ch1 only, so we set stream accordingly. However, the mock_preload is per stimulus, and the driver will send command for ch1 and read back these bytes. So set stream = [0x00, 0x41, 0x00]. Then expected_channels.ch1 = 256.
